pages.title: Ergo Supplies - Wholesale pricing
pages.text:
Wholesale pricing, effective November 2026.

Office chair (model EC-200): $289 per unit, $259 per unit for orders of 20 or more.

pages.title: About Ergo Supplies
pages.text: Ergo Supplies has made ergonomic office furniture in Fremont, California since 2009. We supply retailers across the Bay Area and ship most orders within three business days.

pages.title: Five office equipment trends for 2026
pages.text: Hybrid work keeps reshaping office purchases. Companies are buying fewer desks but more monitors, docking hubs and noise-cancelling headphones. Ergonomic chairs remain the largest single line item for most small businesses, and USB-C hubs are now standard issue.

pages.title: Shipping status lookup
pages.text: Enter a tracking number to see the latest status. Orders placed before November 1 are affected by a regional carrier delay of up to five business days.

pages.title: Northwind returns policy
pages.text: Customers may return unused items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Platinum-tier customers get free return shipping. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within five business days of receiving the item.
